messages:
Ivy Chen: Quick flag for Glacierview onboarding — p95 on /assist up to ~2.3s and token spend ~36% over forecast. Traffic is conversational micro-turns (20-70 tokens) with batch summary jobs at end of sessions. Proactive idea: 1) route micro-turns to a tiny int4 model, 2) enable prefix/KV caching for user sessions, 3) schedule a small Dedicated hedge for their EU evening peak. Thoughts?

Omar Basu: Sounds reasonable. For the micro-turn path we should be conservative: run an int4 pilot on a deterministic selector (header.user_turn == true || token_count <= 80) and keep a quick fallback cascade to the standard model. Need a QA harness focused on brevity-preserving fidelity.

Talia Reed: I'll assemble a 25-case QA set emphasizing instruction-following on short prompts and entity retention for summaries. Also recommend a 24h 3% canary and a quality gate of <=6% regressions.

Kenji Morita: Runtime notes: we can implement routing based on token_count header and add server-side seq_length check. For rollout, suggest 5% -> 20% ramp with automatic rollback if p95 increases >10% or regression_rate >6% sustained for 20m. Also propose prefix cache ttl=240s to balance staleness vs benefit.

Ivy Chen: Draft routing snippet (for eng-runtime):
```json
{
  "route": "/assist",
  "selector": "header.user_turn == true || token_count <= 80",
  "primary_models": ["glacier-compact-1.4b-int4","glacier-compact-1.4b-int8"],
  "fallback": "glacier-standard-3b",
  "cache": {"prefix_kv": true, "ttl_seconds": 240},
  "dedicated_window": "18:00-22:00 Europe/London",
  "observability": ["latency_p95","token_delta","regression_rate"]
}
```

eng-runtime-bot: Canary schedule request received. Please confirm start time and traffic percentage.

Ivy Chen: Propose start=2026-10-12T19:00:00Z, traffic=3%, duration=24h. QA gate: regression_rate <= 6%.

eng-runtime-bot: Canary job scheduled: job_id=glacierview-canary-176500-01, start=2026-10-12T19:00:00Z, traffic=3%, duration=24h. Monitoring hooks: latency_p95, token_delta, regression_rate. Will post results. :gear:

qa-bot: Received QA harness request. Will run Talia's 25-case suite at canary completion and post pass/fail summary with top-5 failures. Gate threshold: regression_rate <= 6%.

Omar Basu: For renewal narrative, CS should present this as a low-effort performance pilot with a concrete savings projection if green. I'll compute estimated token delta and draft a one-slide summary for the account owner.

Talia Reed: After canary, I'll run the harness and capture any fidelity diffs and example failures for PM enablement. If we see systematic misses on entity extraction, we'll tighten selector or raise token cutoff.

Kenji Morita: If pilot is green, recommend gradual ramp and add a staggered Dedicated reserve during peak to guarantee p95. Also include a short rollback playbook in the renewal appendix.

Ivy Chen: Great — updating the renewal tracker (status: pilot-scheduled) and scheduling a 30-min PM enablement session the day after canary completes. Keeping notes here as single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
